create_agent: create an Agent instance with a SceneNode and optional AgentConfiguration for sensor specs and action space
act_agent_action: call Agent.act with an action_id like move_forward or turn_left to execute a movement and check collisions
get_agent_state: call Agent.get_state or access Agent.state to retrieve the current position, rotation, and sensor states as an AgentState object
set_agent_state: call Agent.set_state with an AgentState to reposition the agent and optionally reset or infer sensor states
reconfigure_agent: call Agent.reconfigure with a new AgentConfiguration to recreate sensors and update the agent action space
